name: Status Faktur Pajak
query:
SELECT
    vom.name AS "VAT Output Metadata:Link/VAT Output Metadata:150",
    vom.noinvoice AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
    vom.status AS "Status::100",
    vom.nofa AS "NOFA::150",
    vom.tanggalfaktur AS "Tanggal Faktur:Date:100",
    vom.create_vat_response AS "API Response::200"
FROM
    `tabVAT Output Metadata` vom
WHERE
    vom.status IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    vom.modified DESC
